p20.rule: p20 target priority by congestion (owner 2026-11-08): D3200 delay - lb95(gain) > 0 (over the 10 s group bound labelled, fairness penalty on); D2800 the best fair plan that also cuts delay - lb95 > 0 AND worst group increase <= 10 s; D2400 fairness - worst group increase < 0 AND CVaR90 delay below u0 AND delay not significantly worse (ub95(gain) >= 0); targets with lb95 <= 0 are admitted only by that fairness rule (row admission flag). Where a cell has plans improving BOTH delay (lb95 > 0) and fairness (worst <= 10 s; D2400 worst < 0), only those are kept. Cells without a target: "none" (B trains there like R).
